defect.summary: RP-01 validator rejected role-kind templates with routes:[] (E_ASSET_ROUTE_INVALID) while enforcing global route uniqueness, making the frozen spec section 7.3 production tree (7 role templates, 4 legal routes, READY/PLAN hard error in v1) unsatisfiable; RP-02 could never land.
defect.root_cause: Per-template '>=1 route' mandate was an RP-01 implementation addition beyond the frozen spec text; SS11.1(4) route completeness/unambiguity is route-coverage semantics, not per-template.
defect.discovery: Pre-creation verification for RP-02 (2026-09-06): legacy hashes/IDs verified byte-exact; current v4 template self-declared IDs collected; manifest schema feasibility analysis vs validator rules showed 7 role templates > 4 routes under global uniqueness.

options_presented: Option B: drop per-template mandate, keep global route uniqueness (recommended)
Option C: route-to-role mapping uniqueness, legacy/current share routes

semantics: role-kind templates may declare routes:[] (legacy exact-ID+hash selection per SS7.1; planner pre-cutover non-routable per SS6)
system templates still must not claim action-ready routes (E_ASSET_ROUTE_INVALID)

positive regression proves the full frozen SS7.3 shape validates: 7 role (3 legacy routeless; current executor CLAIM+REVISE, reviewer REVIEW, adjudicator ADJUDICATE, planner routeless) + 3 system, with exact 4-route unambiguous coverage

verification.cargo_test_role_prompt_validator: negative 20 passed; positive 7 passed (5 pre-existing + 2 new); exit=0
